headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: June 13, 2026**
article:
The Miami Marlins secured a crucial 8-3 victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, while the Seattle Mariners dominated the Washington Nationals 10-2. The Baltimore Orioles took down the San Diego Padres 7-3, and the Cleveland Guardians edged out the Detroit Tigers 2-3.

Injuries and availability continue to impact teams across the league. The Milwaukee Brewers placed right-handed pitcher Coleman Crow on the 15-day injured list due to a right forearm flexor strain. The move is retroactive to June 10, 2026. Other notable injuries include Chase Dollander's transfer to the 60-day injured list with a right elbow strain and Seth Lugo's placement on the 7-day injured list with a concussion.

The Cleveland Guardians made their first trade of the season, sending RF Nolan Jones and cash to the Chicago White Sox in exchange for future considerations. The Detroit Tigers acquired RHP Jacob Waguespack from the Milwaukee Brewers. The Philadelphia Phillies traded CF Dylan Campbell and 2B Jose Colmenares to the Chicago White Sox for RF Derek Hill and other considerations.

top_news.title: **Marlins Take Down Pirates 8-3**
top_news.summary: The Miami Marlins secured an 8-3 victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, with Liam Hicks leading the offense and Sandy Alcantara dominating on the mound.

top_news.title: **Mariners Cruise Past Nationals 10-2**
top_news.summary: The Seattle Mariners dominated the Washington Nationals, securing a 10-2 victory. Bryce Miller led the way on the mound, pitching 8.0 innings with 7 strikeouts and 2 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Padres Fall to Orioles in 7-3 Loss**
top_news.summary: The Baltimore Orioles secured a 7-3 victory over the San Diego Padres, with Gunnar Henderson leading the Orioles' offense, going 3-for-3 with a home run and an RBI. Shane Baz earned the win for the Orioles.

top_news.title: **Tigers Fall Short in Cleveland**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers dropped a 2-3 decision to the Cleveland Guardians in their latest matchup. Spencer Torkelson led the Tigers' offense with a home run and an RBI, while Tanner Bibee earned the win for the Guardians with 7 strong innings.

top_news.title: **Coleman Crow Placed on 15-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Milwaukee Brewers right-handed pitcher Coleman Crow has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to a right forearm flexor strain. The move is retroactive to June 10, 2026.

top_news.title: **Cleveland Guardians Make Trade Debut**
top_news.summary: The Cleveland Guardians made their first trade of the season on June 11, 2026, sending RF Nolan Jones and cash to the Chicago White Sox in exchange for future considerations.
